caption: The drawing depicts a detailed, symmetrical collar or necklace-like object arranged in a semicircular composition, primarily outlined in fine black or dark grey lines on a beige or light tan background. The collar consists of a series of repeated, vertically oriented segments radiating outward from a central curved band, each segment having intricate internal line work suggesting texture or woven patterns. Each segment ends with a rounded, rosette-like motif, and the entire piece forms a fan-like spread. In the lower right corner, there is a smaller rectangular inset showing an enlarged detail of the collar’s structure, highlighting the internal pattern and design of one segment. The overall drawing appears carefully rendered with precise, controlled contour lines. The paper shows signs of age, with minor discoloration and a visible central crease.
title: Lace Collar
